subject: Quarterly goal compact — final alignment & QBR packet ask
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: 2027-08-09T08:05:00-07:00
Subject: Quarterly goal compact — final alignment & QBR packet ask

Team —

Attached is the working Q3 Goal Compact (v3) and a first-pass QBR packet we will present to the board peer group on Aug 24. I pulled together the cross-functional owners and the key risks so we can get a single sign-off today if possible. High-level asks: 

- Please review the Objectives & Key Results page (pages 2-4) and confirm owners or propose a single owner swap where two teams overlap.
- Marcus: confirm throughput target on Cost/Latency improvements (OKR 2) — I flagged a potential mismatch with the resource plan.
- Vivek: we need a fast decision on the +2 headcount ask in Platform for KV cache work; impact table attached.
- Laura: can you tighten the executive summary to one slide (I added notes on slide 1)?

We have a tight timeline — the QBR dry run is Aug 17 and the board packet needs final assets by EOD Aug 20. If you can’t sign off in-email, please mark changes in the PDF and add comments in the Drive link below.

Attachments: Q3_Goal_Compact_v3.pdf, QBR_packet_draft-2027-08-09.pptx, Headcount_impact_table.xlsx

Thanks —
Rachel Kim
Head of Product Operations
Redwood Inference

--

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-09T09:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quarterly goal compact — final alignment & QBR packet ask

Thanks Rachel — quick note on OKR 2 (Cost/Latency): I agree with the intent but the numeric target for tokens/sec improvement (40%) is optimistic given current infra plans. I propose we: 

- Move the measurable to 30% for Q3 but add a stretch target of 40% (so we keep ambition without derailing other teams).
- Add a short milestone at 6 weeks for the quantization rollout (owner: Infra, assignee: Priya Natarajan).

I uploaded a diff of the compact with inline comments on page 3. Also, the headcount delta in the impact table assumes two FTEs — can we model the +1 contractor option for faster ramp?

Date: 2027-08-09T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quarterly goal compact — final alignment & QBR packet ask

Agree with Marcus on tempering the public metric to 30% with a clearly labeled stretch to 40%. From a go-to-market POV we should also rephrase OKR 1, KR3 to avoid promising a specific customer revenue uplift until after the pilot concludes with Acme Analytics (we should keep language to "targeted revenue expansion" — want legal/finance to review the final phrasing).

I can take Laura's exec summary edit once she posts it. If everyone can confirm owner assignments by noon PT, I will finalize the go-to-market one-pager and add a single-line risk mitigation for the pilot dependency.

Quick read — headcount ask: we should approve +1 senior SWE in Platform (12-month runway) and evaluate contractor for the second role. Approving both as FTEs today would put pressure on the hiring budget; I’ll ok +1 FTE and ask Talent to scope a 3-month contractor for the second seat.

I also flagged a platform risk on slide 4 (KV cache warmup variance) — I recommend we include a short mitigation note and a fallback metric to keep tail latency below 150ms for 95th pct.

Thanks all — I tightened the executive summary to a single slide and removed two redundancy bullets from the Risks section. I also appended a one-paragraph "ask" for the board that clarifies the requested runway for infra investment. Uploaded revised deck to Drive (link below) and attached an export.

Also looping in Legal (fyi) — we should not commit to customer revenue figures publicly until contractual pilot results are signed. Marcus/Lauren: please confirm the revised phrasing for KR3 by EOD.

Appreciate the quick turn. Summary & decisions: 

- OKR 2 public KR set to 30% with a labelled stretch to 40% (accepted).
- Headcount: approve +1 Platform FTE; pursue contractor for second seat (Vivek/Talent).
- Exec summary: Laura's 1-slide revision accepted; Marcus/Lauren to finalize KR3 phrasing with Legal by EOD tomorrow.
- Risk mitigations: add fallback metric for tail latency (95th < 150ms) and include the KV cache variance note in Risks.

I uploaded the final PDFs to the Drive folder and shared the packet with Acme for feedback on the pilot paragraph (Acme: please comment in Drive by Aug 13). I went ahead and initiated a DocuSign envelope for the pilot Statement of Work so we can move the commercial timing forward — DocuSign will notify when signed.

Planning notes: dry run scheduled Aug 17, board packet final due Aug 20. If there are any last-minute redlines, drop them in the Drive comments and flag me directly.

Thanks —
Rachel Kim
Head of Product Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Q3_Goal_Compact_v3.pdf (final), QBR_packet_final-2027-08-09.pptx
